Forged from a sliver of condensed moonlight and the scale of a lunar wyrm, this
crescent blade phases gently in and out of visibility, humming faintly under the
stars. Its form is tailored for agile swordmasters whose grace intertwines with
arcane instinct.

> “Crescent is the blade that kills, full is the moon’s embrace.”

---

### Attributes

<Attributes />

### Traits

<Trait>

#### Blessing of Küütar

The blade attunes at once, and only once, to anyone the corpse-goddess has blessed, willing or not.

</Trait>

<Trait>

#### Moonlight Glow

Under moonlight the blade sheds cerulean dim light in a [= 1 stride;ADJ =] radius.

</Trait>

### Features

<Feature cost="1 Major Action">

#### Innate Cantrip – Lesser Mooncleave

While Attuned to this weapon, you learn the following cantrip. **Charisma** is your spellcasting ability for it.

<Collapsible open>
  <LesserMooncleave />
</Collapsible>

If you lose attunement to this weapon, you lose **access** to this cantrip until you regain attunement.

</Feature>

<Feature cost="1 Minor Action">

#### Lunar Dissolution

The blade vanishes, or reappears in your hand, in a shimmer of silver mist.

</Feature>

<Feature>

#### Moon Step

When you are [# kw:steady #] you regain [% 1d6 %] hit points, and you gain +1 to Armor Class, saves and checks.
During **Moon Step** You can make one cantrip attack as a Minor Action, using the blade as its focus.
That cantrip gains +1 accuracy and damage.
these benefits last until the start of your next turn.

</Feature>

<Feature cost="1 Major Action" charges="1/[# kw:Repose #], or 3/[# kw:Repose #] with mastery" targets="creatures within a [= 6 stride;ADJ =] cone">

#### Mooncleave <span>Masterful Blow</span>

You sweep the blade in a great lunar arc.
Targets save Dexterity, halving [% 3d8 frost %] and [% 3d8 force %].
The DC gains an accuracy bonus of 1.

</Feature>
